title: Practice 5: Two verbs for every way of going

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Когда вы ___ (лететь — to fly, one way; impf., pres. 2nd pl.)?.
exercises.why: **летите** — present tense (2nd person plural) of лететь: one-direction verb (many directions: летать).

exercises.q: Вы уже ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 2nd pl.)!
exercises.why: **идете** — present tense (2nd person plural) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: За кем ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 2nd pl.)?
exercises.why: **идете** — present tense (2nd person plural) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: Как листья ___ (лететь — to fly, one way; impf., pres. 3rd pl.).

exercises.q: Ну, вон ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 3rd pl.)!

exercises.q: ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 1st sg.) и Гангу.
exercises.why: **иду** — present tense (1st person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
